features.title: Cordis panel and cards read the inventory once per connection
features.summary: The native Cordis sidebar panel and the cordis_define, cordis_run, cordis_stop and cordis_undefine tool cards from one owned fork of the stock row. Behaviour is the native one; the dynamic-plugin inventory read waits for the page's first connected generation instead of being discarded and repeated by its first reset, and later resets still drop and reread it.
features.currentSurface: sidebar footer: Cordis panel, and Cordis tool cards in the transcript

onboarding.firstAction: Open the Cordis panel in the sidebar footer.
onboarding.doneWhen: It lists the dynamic Cordis plugins this Host runs.

failureModes: A refused inventory read is logged by the native panel and the next Cordis event or connection reset reads again.
A page already connected at setup reads at setup, as natively.

externalDependencies.boundary: The dynamicCordisRunner service and Remote methods the panel and cards read; the fork reaches them unchanged.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: tests/inventory-read.test.ts drives the apply() with a typed remote, runner and connection fake.

telemetry.reason: Client-only fork: it calls the native dynamicCordisRunner Remote methods whose Host spans belong to core; the Host half is the native no-op.

verification.testName: is read once at boot: the read waits for the first connected generation, a later one reads again
is read at setup when the page is already connected

verification.reason: The panel and cards are the upstream components byte-identical (node scripts/native-fork-diff.mjs cordis-cards); the delta is how many inventory reads a page load sends, which tests/inventory-read.test.ts counts. A browser walk of the cards needs a dynamic Cordis package defined by a model turn, which no scratch fixture provides yet.
